_note: 独立通道对账 · 子管线（被 lemeng.recon.preagg 的 foreach 派发，每营业日一次）。
判据：湖侧明细按已对齐口径净化后的净额 vs 网关预聚合端点（nhsoft.report.ai.itemsales.find），逐店 diff。
【取参口径】book/bucket/day/settled/门店清单**全部来自父管线 ITER 行**——foreach 只替 ${ITER_*}，
子管线（尤其 tmp/ 直跑时）不吃 ${ENV:} ⇒ 本文件上下文无关，探针态与工作区态同形。
【口径唯一事实源】scripts/lemeng/recon-preagg.sh 头注：
net(店) = Σ_订单[(Σ非赠品行额 + order_total_money)/2] − Σ分摊折扣，只收 FINISHED + SALE_ORDER；
赠品判别式 = std_price>0 AND sale_money>0 AND qty>0 AND |折扣 − 标价×数量| ≤ 0.02；
逐订单归并**不能省**（按行算会把「总额×行数」加进去）；销售侧不扣退货单。
⚠️ 2026-10-17（issue #813）：本管线比的是**净额** = 销售侧 − 退货侧。退货侧 = Σ(sale_money + order_detail_share_discount)，
条件 order_transaction_type like '%RETURN%' AND state='FINISHED'（REPAID_RETURN 不计）。源侧对应 return_money。
源侧缺值按 0（pnormal 两侧 COALESCE(...,0)），与脚本 `or 0` 同源 —— 否则 NULL 传播会让 vbranch/gbranch 误报「湖有而源无」。
【gate ↔ 脚本退出码映射】（判红靠它，与 alerts.json 的 failure/recovery 规则接同一张网）
lguard / gcode  = 脚本 exit 3（依赖不可用）——湖分区空 / 预聚合端点 code≠0
gbranch / gthresh = 脚本 exit 1（判据破）——门店缺 / 差超容差
全静默          = 脚本 exit 0（通过；未定稿日也走这条，只报数不判红）
【为什么先看 envelope（gcode 排在最前）】端点业务失败（如 3120 的恒 10006）是 HTTP 200 +
code≠0，/result/rows 会是空 ⇒ 若不看 envelope 直接比行，会把「依赖坏了」误判成
「全部门店缺失」（假红，且诊断错方向）。rawResponseDestination 落原始报文，
envelope 从字节里抠 code——「对源的疑问从字节答，不靠争」（src.rest 该字段的文档语义）。
【容差】tol = max(200.00, |源合计|×0.01%)（脚本 NET_ABS_TOL / PREAGG_MAX_PCT 同款；地板 200.00 与脚本 NET_ABS_TOL 同源）。
⚠️ 2026-10-17（issue #813）切锚后地板由销售侧的 1.00 改为 200.00：本管线比的是净额 = sale_money − return_money，
200.00 是**退货侧缺口（issue #814 未治本）的过渡带**；pct 项两边完全相同，只差地板 —— 不改就是同一份数据
「脚本判 PREAGG_NET_DRIFT(rc 0)、管线判 gthresh 死(exit 1)」，排班面天天假红。
issue #814（退货侧缺口治本）修完 ⇒ 本值归 0，与销售侧同款逐分。
【两档】settled 由父管线按 T-3 定线传入；violation SQL 恒带 settled=1 条件 ⇒ 未定稿日
两闸恒静默、report 照写 = 「只报数不判红」（脚本 PREAGG_UNSETTLED 同义）。
【产物】/workspace/reports/recon-preagg/recon-<book>-<bizday>.csv（逐店明细，单对象覆盖=幂等）；
owners.lemeng.json 以 *.csv maximumAge 36h 作「没有失败的停更」锚（close.l1 同公式：24h+12h）。
源有而湖无的门店（当日无销售）按脚本同款**只在明细里可见、不判红**。
【2026-10-18 落湖】新增 sinkprep + lakeout（snk.minio）：逐店两侧事实落 lemeng/recon_preagg/system_book=/bizday=/chunk=/all.parquet。
只落**事实**（两侧 4 个金额）；容差/判定/原因**不进湖**（配置归 seed、判定归 dbt）。
父管线已切块（≤100 家/块）⇒ 子管线每块一跑；chunk_no 经 ${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO} 进来。
【2026-10-18 判据闸退役】`vthresh` / `gthresh` / `vbranch` / `gbranch` 四个节点已删除。
理由（真跑实证）：旧 `gthresh` 是 `ctl.die`——总差超容差即整条 run 死 ⇒ sink 不执行、
后续块永不执行。而「净额侧容差 200」本是 issue #814（退货晚到）的**过渡活口**，
意味着**只要 #814 没关，这条管线就永远不可能成功落数据**（历史上 last_run_at=null 即此）。
界线：**采集只该因「拿不到」而死**（`lguard` 湖空 / `pguard` T-3 无行 / `gcode` 网关报错 —— 三个都保留），
**不该因「数不一样」而死**。判定归 dbt：`recon_run` 四态（ok/within_tol/over_tol/not_evaluated）
+ `recon_break`（原因/到期/认领）。在管线里再判一次 = 同一判据的第二份实现。

data.label: lguard 湖空即死（exit3 语义）

properties.message: recon 依赖不可用（lake_unavailable）：bizday=${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY} 分区为空——采集未跑或分区缺失

data.label: lagg 湖侧净化净额（逐订单归并，口径=recon-preagg.sh）

properties.sql:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS b,
         CAST(order_no AS VARCHAR) AS o,
         sum(CASE WHEN CAST(order_detail_std_price AS DOUBLE) > 0
                    AND CAST(sale_money AS DOUBLE) > 0
                    AND CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE) > 0
                    AND abs(CAST(discount_money AS DOUBLE)
                            - CAST(order_detail_std_price AS DOUBLE) * CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE)) <= 0.02
                  THEN 0 ELSE CAST(sale_money AS DOUBLE) END) AS ng,
         max(CAST(order_total_money AS DOUBLE)) AS tot,
         sum(CAST(order_detail_share_discount AS DOUBLE)) AS sd
  FROM "lguard"
  WHERE CAST(state AS VARCHAR) = 'FINISHED'
    AND CAST(order_transaction_type AS VARCHAR) = 'SALE_ORDER'
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
sale_side AS (
  SELECT b, round(sum((ng + tot) / 2 - sd), 2) AS sale_net FROM per_order GROUP BY b),
ret_side AS (
  SELECT CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS b,
         round(sum(CAST(sale_money AS DOUBLE) + CAST(order_detail_share_discount AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS ret
  FROM "lguard"
  WHERE CAST(order_transaction_type AS VARCHAR) like '%RETURN%'
    AND CAST(state AS VARCHAR) = 'FINISHED'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(s.b, t.b) AS branch_num,
       coalesce(s.sale_net, 0) AS sale,
       coalesce(s.sale_net, 0) - coalesce(t.ret, 0) AS net,
       'lake' AS side
FROM sale_side s FULL JOIN ret_side t ON s.b = t.b ORDER BY 1

data.label: pre 预聚合端点（branch 汇总）+ 原始报文落盘
pnormal 源侧行定型（对齐湖侧形状）

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       CAST(COALESCE(sale_money, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS sale,
       CAST(COALESCE(sale_money, 0) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(COALESCE(return_money, 0) AS DOUBLE) AS net,
       'pre' AS side
FROM input

data.label: diff 逐店透视（两侧销售/净额；任一侧缺=NULL）

properties.sql:
SELECT CAST(branch_num AS INTEGER) AS branch_num,
       max(CASE WHEN side = 'lake' THEN sale END) AS platform_sale,
       max(CASE WHEN side = 'pre'  THEN sale END) AS source_sale,
       max(CASE WHEN side = 'lake' THEN net  END) AS platform_net,
       max(CASE WHEN side = 'pre'  THEN net  END) AS source_net,
       round(max(CASE WHEN side = 'pre' THEN net END)
           - max(CASE WHEN side = 'lake' THEN net END), 2) AS diff
FROM input GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

data.label: report 逐店明细落盘（覆盖写=幂等）
sinkprep 落湖行定型（补 batch_id/分区列/时点）

properties.sql:
SELECT
  '${ITER_ITEM_BATCH_ID}' AS batch_id,
  '${ITER_ITEM_SYSTEM_BOOK}' AS system_book,
  CAST('${ITER_ITEM_BIZDAY}' AS DATE) AS bizday,
  CAST(${ITER_ITEM_CHUNK_NO} AS INTEGER) AS chunk_no,
  CAST(branch_num AS BIGINT) AS branch_num,
  CAST(platform_sale AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS platform_sale,
  CAST(source_sale AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS source_sale,
  CAST(platform_net AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS platform_net,
  CAST(source_net AS DECIMAL(20, 2)) AS source_net,
  CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AS computed_at
FROM "diff"
